name: Park MGM Las Vegas
insider_take: Park MGM brings a refreshing, eco-conscious vibe to the Vegas Strip with its smoke-free gaming floor and botanical-inspired design.
whats_special: Park MGM is the only smoke-free casino on the Strip, featuring a stunning 40-foot living moss wall and over 2,000 trees throughout the property. The hotel's NoMad Las Vegas occupies floors 46-50, creating a boutique hotel-within-a-hotel experience with its own dedicated elevator and entrance.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 20-28 for the best value with excellent Strip views, avoiding the premium NoMad rates while still enjoying the property's unique amenities.
dont_miss: The Park Theater hosts A-list residencies (Lady Gaga, Bruno Mars), while the adjacent Park district offers outdoor dining with the iconic Bliss Dance sculpture. Experience Eataly's 40,000-square-foot Italian marketplace – the largest in the Western United States.
pros: Prime Strip location with easy access to T-Mobile Arena and entertainment venues
Modern, stylish rooms with contemporary design and upscale amenities
Diverse dining options including celebrity chef restaurants and casual eateries
Vibrant casino floor with extensive gaming options and entertainment
cons: Can be crowded and noisy due to central Strip location
Resort fees and parking charges apply
